name: London Ambulance Service
description:
The London Ambulance Service dispatches ambulances in emergencies. The key goal is to allocate an available ambulance for every call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes. The entire dispatch process must not exceed a set maximum time limit.

To make this work, the Computer Aided Despatch system analyzes incident forms and assigns vehicles. It is vital to track the exact location of moving ambulances. This requires ambulance staff to follow standard routes and correctly communicate departure and destination information, allowing radio operators and the CAD system to record data accurately.
rawDescription:
The London Ambulance Service dispatches ambulances in emergencies. The key goal is to allocate an available ambulance for every call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes. The entire dispatch process must not exceed a set maximum time limit.

To make this work, the Computer Aided Despatch system analyzes incident forms and assigns vehicles. It is vital to track the exact location of moving ambulances. This requires ambulance staff to follow standard routes and correctly communicate departure and destination information, allowing radio operators and the CAD system to record data accurately.
highLevelGoals: Minimize response time to ensure every emergency call is reached within 11 minutes.
Record precise departure and destination information to support efficient resource allocation.
Track the exact location of ambulances in motion to optimize routing and response.
Allow emergency callers to quickly report incidents and initiate the dispatch process.
lowLevelGoals: The Dispatcher assigns an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt.
The Radio Operator logs the exact departure time and GPS coordinates of the assigned ambulance.
The Radio Operator logs the destination address and arrival time of the ambulance at the scene.
The Ambulance Driver sends GPS coordinates to the system every 30 seconds while en route.
The Emergency Caller dials the emergency number and triggers the system to log the incident details.
The Emergency Caller submits location, nature of emergency, and contact information via the system interface.
